values.catalogue:
Industrial IoT & Telemetry Aggregation — Vehicle Telematics, AI Edge Server / Video Analytics Interfaces with multiple IP cameras and edge AI processing systems, Telecom and Network Monitoring Equipment
Remote Substation & Utility Monitoring — Ideal for connecting energy meters, RTUs, and utility equipment using RS485/RS232 interfaces for real-time monitoring and data transmission.
Secure Smart Edge Gateway for Transportation / Fleet Management — The 4G/5G cellular connectivity paired with 4 Gigabit Ethernet ports lets it aggregate data from multiple field sensors and PLCs, then backhaul it over cellular where wired internet isn't available. Its -20°C to 75°C operating range and fanless design suit outdoor cabinets or remote plant sites.
